# G2 一套简明和渐进式的可视化语法 | AntV

> G2 是一套简洁的渐进式可视化语法，用于构建仪表盘、数据探索以及数据讲故事。结合工业和学术实践，实现图形语法、动画语法和交互语法。

Use the Markdown links below for machine-readable content; canonical page links are the authoritative human-facing URLs.

## Agent resources

- [Full documentation](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/llms-full.txt): Combined Markdown content for all published documents.
- [Canonical site](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/antvis/g2)
- Languages: zh, en
- Current version: 5.4.8

## 中文文档

### charts

- [📈 图表介绍](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/overview.md): 浏览 G2 图表类型、适用场景和可运行示例，按数据关系选择条形图、折线图、散点图、地图及关系图。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/overview/)
- [弧长连接图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/arcdiagram.md): 用沿直线或圆周排列的节点与弧线展示关系，了解节点排序、连接模式及 G2 弧长连接图示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/arcdiagram/)
- [马赛克图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/mosaic.md): 用矩形面积和分割比例表达分类数据的频数关系，了解马赛克图的使用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/mosaic/)
- [柱状图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bar.md): 用柱子的高度或长度比较不同类别的数值，了解柱状图的数据要求、适用场景及 G2 绘制示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bar/)
- [气泡图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bubble-chart.md): 在散点位置之外用气泡大小表达额外数值，了解气泡图的数据映射、比较方式及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bubble-chart/)
- [色块图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/color-map.md): 将数据映射到矩形色块，通过颜色比较类别组合的数值，了解色块图的适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/color-map/)
- [分布曲线图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/distributioncurve.md): 用平滑曲线观察数值分布的形状、集中程度和多个峰值，了解分布曲线图的使用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/distributioncurve/)
- [点描法地图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/dot-map.md): 用地图上的点表达地理位置或数量分布，了解点描法地图的表现方式、适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/dot-map/)
- [直方图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/histogram.md): 将连续数据划分为区间并统计频数，了解直方图与柱状图的区别、分箱选择及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/histogram/)
- [折线图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/line.md): 连接连续观测值以展示变化趋势，了解折线图的数据要求、多系列比较及 G2 绘制示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/line/)
- [分组柱状图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/multi-set-bar.md): 将多个系列的柱子按类别并排放置，了解分组柱状图的比较方式、适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/multi-set-bar/)
- [打包图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/pack.md): 用嵌套或排列的圆展示层级结构和数值大小，了解打包图的布局特点、适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/pack/)
- [平行坐标系](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/parallel.md): 将多个数据维度排列为平行轴，用折线连接同一记录，了解平行坐标系的多维分析方法及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/parallel/)
- [玉珏图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/radial-bar.md): 用不同半径上的弧长表达类别数值，了解玉珏图的环形布局、比较方式及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/radial-bar/)
- [回归曲线图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/regressioncurve.md): 用拟合曲线概括变量之间的关系和趋势，了解回归曲线图的分析用途及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/regressioncurve/)
- [堆叠面积图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/stacked-area.md): 将多个系列的面积逐层堆叠，观察总量与各部分随时间的变化，了解堆叠面积图和 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/stacked-area/)
- [堆叠柱状图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/stacked-bar.md): 将各系列数值累积到同一柱中，比较类别总量及组成，了解堆叠柱状图的适用场景和 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/stacked-bar/)
- [茎叶图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/stem-leaf.md): 把数值拆分为茎和叶，在保留原始数值的同时展示分布，了解茎叶图的统计用途及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/stem-leaf/)
- [旭日图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/sunburst.md): 用嵌套的环形扇区表示层级结构与数值占比，了解旭日图的阅读方式、适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/sunburst/)
- [矩形树图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/treemap.md): 用嵌套矩形的面积表达层级数据的数值大小，了解矩形树图的布局特点、适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/treemap/)
- [韦恩图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/venn.md): 用相交区域展示集合间的交集与包含关系，了解韦恩图的适用场景、数据表达方式及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/venn/)
- [小提琴图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/violin.md): 结合密度分布形状与统计概要比较多组数据，了解小提琴图与箱形图的区别及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/violin/)
- [面积图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/area.md): 用填充面积展示数值随时间的变化，了解面积图与折线图的区别、适用场景及 G2 配置示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/area/)
- [箱形图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/boxplot.md): 通过中位数、四分位数和异常值概括数据分布，了解箱形图的统计含义、适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/boxplot/)
- [带气泡的地图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bubble-map.md): 在地图上用气泡位置与大小展示地理分布和数值差异，了解带气泡地图的适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bubble-map/)
- [雷达图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/radar-chart.md): 将多个指标排列在放射状坐标轴上，对比对象的指标轮廓，了解雷达图的适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/radar-chart/)
- [双向柱状图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bi-directional-bar.md): 将两组数据沿相反方向排列，比较不同群体或正负数值，了解双向柱状图的使用场景和 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bi-directional-bar/)
- [饼图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/pie.md): 用扇形角度和面积表达各部分占总体的比例，了解饼图的适用条件、类别数量限制及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/pie/)
- [环图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/donut-chart.md): 用环形扇区展示各类别占总体的比例，了解环图与饼图的区别、适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/donut-chart/)
- [热力图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/heatmap.md): 用颜色强度表现数值或空间密度，了解热力图的数据映射、分布分析场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/heatmap/)
- [分级统计地图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/choropleth-map.md): 按地理区域的数值设置颜色深浅或色阶，了解分级统计地图的数据要求、区域比较方式及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/choropleth-map/)
- [漏斗图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/funnel.md): 展示连续流程中各阶段的数量及转化情况，了解漏斗图在转化分析中的应用和 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/funnel/)
- [K线图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/k-chart.md): 用开盘、收盘、最高和最低价格描述行情变化，了解 K 线图的结构、金融分析场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/k-chart/)
- [散点图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/scatter-plot.md): 将两个数值变量映射到平面位置，观察相关性、聚类与异常点，了解散点图的使用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/scatter-plot/)
- [仪表盘](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/gauge.md): 在刻度范围内展示当前指标及其所处区间，了解仪表盘图的组成、监控场景和 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/gauge/)
- [南丁格尔玫瑰图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/rose.md): 在等角扇区中用半径表达类别数值，了解南丁格尔玫瑰图与饼图的区别及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/rose/)
- [等高线图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/contourline.md): 用等值线表达二维空间中连续数值的分布，了解等高线图在地形和密度分析中的应用及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/contourline/)
- [螺旋图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/spiral.md): 沿螺旋路径排列数据，观察时间序列的周期与长期变化，了解螺旋图的适用场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/spiral/)
- [词云图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/wordcloud.md): 用文字大小表达词语的重要程度或频次，了解词云图的布局、文本展示场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/wordcloud/)
- [子弹图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bullet.md): 在紧凑空间内对照实际值、目标值与评价区间，了解子弹图的结构、指标对比场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/bullet/)
- [桑基图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/sankey.md): 用连接带宽度表达节点间的流量，了解桑基图在流程、能源和资金流向分析中的应用及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/sankey/)
- [甘特图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/gantt.md): 用时间轴上的横条表示任务开始、结束和持续时间，了解甘特图的进度管理场景及 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/gantt/)
- [卡吉图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/kagi.md): 根据价格变化方向和反转幅度绘制折线，了解卡吉图的趋势表达方式、组成要素与适用场景。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/kagi/)
- [和弦图](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/chord.md): 用圆周上的分组和连接带表达群体间的联系及规模，了解和弦图的适用场景和 G2 示例。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/charts/chord/)

- [概览](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/manual/core/coordinate/overview.md): 了解 G2 坐标系及其转换，配置笛卡尔坐标、极坐标和转置等变换，控制图表的空间布局。 — [页面](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/zh/manual/core/coordinate/overview/)

## English documentation

### charts

- [📈 Chart Gallery](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/overview.md): Explore G2 chart types, use cases, and runnable examples to choose charts for comparisons, trends, distributions, maps, and relationships. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/overview/)
- [Arc Diagram](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/arcdiagram.md): Show relationships with nodes arranged on a line or circle and connected by arcs. Explore node ordering, connection patterns, and G2 arc diagram examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/arcdiagram/)
- [Mosaic Plot](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/mosaic.md): Use rectangular areas and partition proportions to show frequencies in categorical data. Explore mosaic chart use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/mosaic/)
- [Bar Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bar.md): Compare values across categories using bar height or length. Learn about bar chart data requirements, use cases, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bar/)
- [Bubble Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bubble-chart.md): Use bubble size to encode an additional value alongside scatterplot positions. Explore bubble chart mappings, comparisons, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bubble-chart/)
- [Color Map](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/color-map.md): Map data to rectangular cells and compare values across category combinations through color. Explore cell chart use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/color-map/)
- [Distribution Curve](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/distributioncurve.md): Use smooth curves to inspect distribution shape, concentration, and multiple peaks. Explore distribution curve use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/distributioncurve/)
- [Dot Map](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/dot-map.md): Use dots on a map to represent geographic locations or quantity distributions. Explore dot map encodings, use cases, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/dot-map/)
- [Histogram Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/histogram.md): Group continuous data into bins and count observations. Learn how histograms differ from bar charts, choose bins, and explore G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/histogram/)
- [Line Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/line.md): Connect successive observations to show trends. Explore line chart data requirements, comparisons across series, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/line/)
- [Pack Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/pack.md): Use nested or packed circles to show hierarchy and magnitude. Explore circle packing layouts, use cases, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/pack/)
- [Parallel Coordinates](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/parallel.md): Arrange dimensions as parallel axes and connect each record across them. Explore multivariate analysis with parallel coordinates and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/parallel/)
- [Radial Bar Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/radial-bar.md): Encode category values with arc lengths at different radii. Explore radial bar chart layouts, comparisons, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/radial-bar/)
- [Regression Curve Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/regressioncurve.md): Summarize relationships and trends between variables with a fitted curve. Explore regression curve analysis and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/regressioncurve/)
- [Stacked Area Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/stacked-area.md): Stack areas from multiple series to show totals and changing contributions over time. Explore stacked area charts and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/stacked-area/)
- [Stacked Bar Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/stacked-bar.md): Stack series within each bar to compare category totals and composition. Explore stacked bar chart use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/stacked-bar/)
- [Stem-and-Leaf Plot](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/stem-leaf.md): Split values into stems and leaves to show distributions while retaining individual values. Explore stem-and-leaf plots and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/stem-leaf/)
- [Sunburst Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/sunburst.md): Use nested rings of sectors to show hierarchy and proportions. Learn to read sunburst charts and explore their use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/sunburst/)
- [Treemap](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/treemap.md): Use nested rectangle areas to encode values in hierarchical data. Explore treemap layouts, use cases, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/treemap/)
- [Venn Diagram](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/venn.md): Use overlapping regions to show set intersections and inclusion. Explore Venn diagram use cases, data encodings, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/venn/)
- [Violin Plot](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/violin.md): Compare groups using density shapes and statistical summaries. Learn how violin plots differ from box plots and explore G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/violin/)
- [Area Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/area.md): Show changes over time with filled areas. Learn when to use area charts, how they differ from line charts, and how to create them with G2. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/area/)
- [Box Plot](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/boxplot.md): Summarize distributions with medians, quartiles, and outliers. Learn how to interpret box plots and build them with G2. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/boxplot/)
- [Bubble Map](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bubble-map.md): Use bubble positions and sizes on a map to show geographic distributions and differences in magnitude. Explore use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bubble-map/)
- [Radar Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/radar-chart.md): Arrange metrics on radial axes to compare profiles across objects. Explore radar chart use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/radar-chart/)
- [Bi-directional Bar Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bi-directional-bar.md): Arrange two groups of bars in opposite directions to compare populations or positive and negative values. Explore diverging bar chart use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bi-directional-bar/)
- [Multi-set Bar Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/multi-set-bar.md): Place bars from multiple series side by side within categories. Explore grouped bar chart comparisons, use cases, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/multi-set-bar/)
- [Pie Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/pie.md): Use sectors to show parts of a whole. Learn when pie charts are suitable, how category count affects readability, and explore G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/pie/)
- [Donut Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/donut-chart.md): Show category shares with ring-shaped sectors. Learn how donut charts differ from pie charts and explore their use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/donut-chart/)
- [Heatmap](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/heatmap.md): Use color intensity to show values or spatial density. Explore heatmap encodings, distribution analysis, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/heatmap/)
- [Choropleth Map](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/choropleth-map.md): Color geographic regions by their values to compare spatial patterns. Learn choropleth map data requirements and explore G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/choropleth-map/)
- [Funnel Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/funnel.md): Show quantities and conversion across successive process stages. Explore funnel charts for conversion analysis with G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/funnel/)
- [K-Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/k-chart.md): Describe price movements with open, close, high, and low values. Learn candlestick chart structure and financial analysis use cases with G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/k-chart/)
- [Scatter Plot](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/scatter-plot.md): Map two numerical variables to positions to inspect correlations, clusters, and outliers. Explore scatterplot use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/scatter-plot/)
- [Gauge Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/gauge.md): Show a current metric within a scale and its ranges. Learn gauge chart components and monitoring use cases with G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/gauge/)
- [Nightingale Rose Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/rose.md): Use radial extent in equal-angle sectors to represent category values. Learn how rose charts differ from pie charts and explore G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/rose/)
- [Contour Line Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/contourline.md): Use contour lines to show continuous values across two-dimensional space. Explore applications in terrain and density analysis with G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/contourline/)
- [Spiral](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/spiral.md): Arrange data along a spiral to inspect cycles and long-term changes in time series. Explore spiral chart use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/spiral/)
- [Word Cloud](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/wordcloud.md): Use text size to encode word importance or frequency. Explore word cloud layouts, text visualization use cases, and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/wordcloud/)
- [Bullet Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bullet.md): Compare actual values, targets, and performance ranges in a compact chart. Learn the structure of bullet charts and explore G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/bullet/)
- [Sankey Diagram](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/sankey.md): Encode flows between nodes with link widths. Explore Sankey diagrams for process, energy, and financial flows with G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/sankey/)
- [Gantt Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/gantt.md): Represent task starts, ends, and durations with bars on a timeline. Explore Gantt charts for schedule tracking with G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/gantt/)
- [Kagi Chart](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/kagi.md): Draw lines based on price direction and reversal magnitude. Learn how Kagi charts express trends, their components, and when to use them. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/kagi/)
- [Chord Diagram](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/chord.md): Show relationships and their magnitude with groups around a circle and connecting ribbons. Explore chord diagram use cases and G2 examples. — [Canonical page](https://g2.antv.antgroup.com/en/charts/chord/)
